# Coverage

<!-- Generated by TestCoverageDoc (internal/app/coverage_test.go); do not
edit. Regenerate with: go test ./internal/app -run TestCoverageDoc -update -->

Every operation WeiStack serves, by service, with the IAM action that
authorizes it under `-iam=enforce` (see [Checking credentials](enforce.md)).
A request for anything else answers `501 WeiStack.0501`. The pages under
[services](services/) describe each operation's behaviour and gaps.

| Service | API versions | Operations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ECS](#ecs) | v1, v2.1 | 24 |
| [ELB](#elb) | v3 (dedicated) | 82 |
| [EPS](#eps) | v1.0 (the default enterprise project) | 1 |
| [EVS](#evs) | v2, v2.1 | 19 |
| [IAM](#iam) | v3, v3.0, v5 (users, groups, tokens, access keys, roles, custom policies, role assignments, identity policies) | 133 |
| [IMS](#ims) | v1, v2 | 7 |
| [KMS](#kms) | v1.0 (keys, encryption, data keys, rotation, tags) | 56 |
| [NAT](#nat) | v2 (public), v3 (private, tags) | 73 |
| [OBS](#obs) | S3-compatible | 31 |
| [RDS](#rds) | v3 | 12 |
| [STS](#sts) | v5 (caller identity, authorization messages, assuming agencies) | 3 |
| [VPC](#vpc) | v1, v3 | 66 |

## OBS

Endpoint: `obs.{region}.myhuaweicloud.com`. Details: [OBS](services/obs.md).

OBS serves every request through one route and picks the operation from the
method, the path and the query. The operations it serves, by IAM action:

- `obs:bucket:createBucket`
- `obs:bucket:deleteBucket`
